exposure: Type of cesarean section (primary vs. repeat)
mode of administration of uterotonic drugs
Methergine use as second-line uterotonic management
outcome: Type, dose, and mode of administration of uterotonic drugs
Knowledge regarding side effects of uterotonic drugs
cohort: 391 obstetricians and anesthesiologists in seven University hospitals in Israel
finding: There was significant variability in attitudes and practices regarding uterotonic management between obstetricians and anesthesiologists.
mod_finding: Both obstetricians and anesthesiologists reported using an aggressive approach for oxytocin administration during primary cesarean section, with a high bolus dosage.
